title: CMDash connector definition
description: The shareable, non-secret shape a ConnectorTemplate.definition (and a CustomConnector row) carries — item 1.1/1.4 of ROADMAP-COMPETITIVE. This is DATA, never code: an HTTP request template plus a JSONPath field-mapping list, with no credential anywhere in it. Portable JSON Schema so a contributor can validate a candidate definition with any tool in any language, not only validate.mjs in this folder — see README.md.

endpointUrl.description: Must be http(s). CMDash additionally requires this to resolve to a PUBLIC address at both save time and run time (SSRF protection, apps/api/src/common/ssrf.ts) — a check this schema cannot express, since it depends on live DNS.

requestHeaders.description: Static, NON-SECRET headers only. A credential belongs in the tenant's own auth profile at install time, never in a header template — CMDash's server-side validator scans for this but a contributor should not rely on that as the only check.

authType.description: Authorization-code OAuth2 is deliberately not a value here — see docs/integration-setup-custom-connector.md.

jsonPath.description: A DELIBERATELY NARROW subset: $, .name, ['name'], [0], [*] only. No filter expressions ([?(...)]), no recursive descent (..), no slices, no unions, no parentheses — see validate.mjs's parseJsonPath, which is the authoritative parity copy of apps/api/src/integration/custom/json-path.ts. This schema cannot express the grammar itself (JSON Schema has no context-free-grammar constraint); run validate.mjs for that half of the check.

observationType.description: Required when target is OBSERVATION; must be absent or ignored when target is EVIDENCE. This is a FROZEN vocabulary (schema.prisma's own comment: 'a new source class is a change to the design doc + this enum, never an adapter-local decision') — do not invent a value outside this list.
